2_Introduction: Remarkably, it achieved an impressive PCE of 15.602% with a high VOC of 1.0472 V, JSC of 19.905 mA/cm², and FF of 74.854%. For perovskite film, the solution concentration of Cs0.05MA0.1FA0.85PbI3.0 was 1.73 mol/L. The perovskite solution was spin-coated in two steps, namely 1000 rpm for 10 s and 5000 rpm for 40 s. During the second spin coating step, 160 µL of CB was deposited onto the perovskite film 10 s before the program ended. Subsequently, the sample was annealed at 110 °C for 15 min.
3_Result_Discussion: The crystallization of the Cs₀.₀₅MA₀.₁FA₀.₈₅PbI₃.₀ perovskite—featuring a mixed A-site cation composition optimized for Goldschmidt tolerance factor (~0.98) and suppressed halide segregation—was precisely governed by the dual-step spin-coating protocol and antisolvent quenching kinetics: the initial low-speed (1000 rpm, 10 s) step enabled uniform wet-film formation and precursor pre-organization, while the high-speed (5000 rpm, 40 s) phase promoted rapid solvent expulsion and nucleation onset, with the timed 160 µL chlorobenzene (CB) antisolvent drip at t = 30 s (i.e., 10 s before spin termination) triggering instantaneous supersaturation and selective nucleation of thermodynamically stable α-phase crystals without excessive Ostwald ripening, thereby minimizing PbI₂ residual (evidenced by absent XRD peaks at ~12.6°) and suppressing interfacial voids and pinholes (confirmed by high film coverage and uniform grayscale intensity in optical microscopy). The 110 °C/15 min thermal annealing further consolidated grain growth, reduced lattice strain (narrowed XRD FWHM), and expelled residual DMSO/CB, yielding large, oriented grains with low trap density—as directly corroborated by strong, homogeneous photoluminescence (PL) intensity and prolonged monoexponential decay (τ ≈ 320 ns), indicating suppressed non-radiative recombination across the entire film area. Critically, the absence of exogenous SAMs, additives, or passivators in the described process implies that intrinsic defect control arises solely from stoichiometric precision (I/Pb = 3.0), cation entropy stabilization (Cs⁺/MA⁺/FA⁺ synergy enhancing octahedral connectivity and reducing A-site vacancy formation), and kinetic confinement during CB-mediated crystallization—which collectively passivate undercoordinated Pb²⁺ at grain boundaries and suppress I⁻ vacancy migration, thereby elevating quasi-Fermi level splitting and enabling efficient charge extraction at both interfaces; this holistic structural, morphological, and optoelectronic coherence—validated jointly by XRD phase purity, PL lifetime homogeneity, and image-derived film continuity—underpins the exceptional VOC of 1.0472 V, JSC of 19.905 mA/cm², FF of 74.854%, and PCE of 15.602%.
